blogPosts.title: How to identify high-quality plant-based cat litter
blogPosts.excerpt: Material, absorbency, dust, and odor control. A simple 4-point quality method for buyers.
blogPosts.content: Material is the core. A superior plant-based litter uses natural pea fiber, corn, or cassava. Second is absorbency rate. Third is dust rate, kept under 3 percent. Fourth is odor control rate; the 10-minute metric is a clear standard for buyers.
